import json
def ex(n,a): return execute_tool(n, json.dumps(a))["returnValue"]
def run():
    R="{lab_mount}"
    bp=ex("UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet.CreateWidgetBlueprint",{"folderPath":R+"/{folder}","assetName":"{name}","parentClass":{"refPath":"/Script/UMG.UserWidget"}})
    p=bp["refPath"] if isinstance(bp,dict) else str(bp)
    root=ex("UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet.AddWidget",{"widgetBlueprint":p,"widgetClass":{"refPath":"/Script/UMG.Overlay"},"widgetDisplayName":"Root","parentWidget":None})
    ex("UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet.AddWidget",{"widgetBlueprint":p,"widgetClass":{"refPath":"/Script/UMG.StackBox"},"widgetDisplayName":"Stack","parentWidget":root["widget"]})
    c=ex("UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet.CompileWidgetBlueprint",{"widgetBlueprint":p})
    s=ex("editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools.save_assets",{"asset_paths":[R+"/{folder}/{name}"]})
    e=ex("editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools.exists",{"path":R+"/{folder}/{name}"})
    d=ex("editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools.is_dirty",{"asset_path":R+"/{folder}/{name}"})
    return {"compile":c,"saved":s,"exists":e,"dirty":d,"n":len(ex("UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet.GetWidgets",{"widgetBlueprint":p})["widgets"])}
